title: Gland Pharma Gets USFDA EIR with No Action Indicated Status for Visakhapatnam Facility

contentHtml:
Hyderabad: Gland Pharma Limited has received an Establishment Inspection Report (EIR) from the United States Food and Drug Administration (USFDA), classifying its Visakhapatnam-based VSEZ Sterile Oncology Formulations Facility as No Action Indicated (NAI) following a routine Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) inspection conducted between August 24 and September 1, 2026.

The inspection covered the company's VSEZ Sterile Oncology Formulations Facility and API Facility at Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh. Following the inspection, the USFDA issued the EIR, indicating closure of the inspection with an NAI classification.

The No Action Indicated classification signifies that the inspection has been closed without recommending regulatory action based on the inspection findings.

The development follows the company's earlier intimation dated September 1, 2026, regarding the USFDA inspection at the facilities. With the receipt of the EIR, the company has confirmed the closure of the inspection process.

Gland Pharma Limited is a pharmaceutical company engaged in the development, manufacturing and marketing of injectable formulations. Its product portfolio includes sterile injectables across various therapeutic segments, including oncology, with operations serving domestic and international markets.
